newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to lower ahead of OPEC tal.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to lower ahead of OPEC tal.

text.p: NWE products were steady to lower on Monday ahead of this week's OPEC meeting.
Gas oil eased around 50 cents on futures. Premiums were unchanged to softer with volume curbed by a standoff over the November IPE delivery.
Fuel oil prices were steady but sentiment was firm on cold weather in Europe and the United States.
Naphtha fell a bit but any correction to last week's rally was seen cushioned by strong propane prices and tighter supplies after cargoes were fixed for the U.S.
Gasoline steadied ahead of Tuesday's U.K. budget.
